primary_intent: Create and save a new Triage encounter for patient p1 with the exact note 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note,' saving once and making no other changes. A reasonable user would not be flexible about the save actually succeeding (the record must be created), but would be fine with normal UI defaults or navigation.
reasoning: Nitpicks: None — the agent used the correct app, opened patient p1, selected Triage, and entered the exact note. Critical issues: The encounter was not saved due to a server timeout, so the primary deliverable (a committed encounter) is missing. Critical-Point decision: This matches the rule 'FAILURE: an environment blocker prevented the agent from reaching the CP at all' — the agent attempted to save once as authorized, but the server did not respond and the record was not created. Outcome analysis: Screenshots confirm 'Encounter for patient p1' with 'Type: Triage' and the exact note text entered, along with a banner stating 'The server did not answer. Try again later.' No unrelated changes were made. However, because the save did not complete, the user’s fundamental goal (a saved/committed encounter) was not met.

items.criterion: Use the clinic's record app as the platform
items.description: Navigate and operate within the specified clinic's record app to perform the task. Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.
items.justification: All actions occurred on http://clinic.example within the clinic's record app (new encounter form). No alternative platforms were used.
items.applicable_evidence: Single (latest) screenshot shows the clinic app at http://clinic.example/encounter/new with an encounter form UI and in-app error banner.
items.post_image_justification: The interface is clearly the clinic's record app; no alternative platform was used.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'
items.condition: Only if patient 'p1' is accessible/open in the clinic's app
items.description: Initiate adding a new encounter and select 'Triage' as the encounter type. Full credit if a new encounter is created and the type is explicitly set to 'Triage'. Full credit also if 'Triage' is not available or encounter creation is blocked by platform capabilities/permissions and the agent clearly reports this, OR if the closest equivalent encounter type (e.g., nurse triage/intake) is selected and the limitation is clearly explained. Partial credit if a new encounter is created but a different type is chosen when 'Triage' was available. No credit if no attempt to initiate a new encounter is made.
items.justification: With p1's new-encounter form open, the agent set the 'Type' field to 'Triage' (Action 1).
items.applicable_evidence: Single (latest) screenshot shows the form field 'Type: Triage'.
items.post_image_justification: The new encounter was initiated and the type set to Triage.

items.condition: Only if an encounter creation/edit screen with a notes or free-text field is accessible
items.description: Input the note text exactly as provided: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note. Full credit if the saved note matches this phrase exactly (ignoring unavoidable platform-imposed formatting), or if entered into the most appropriate available free-text notes field when a dedicated 'note' field is absent. Full credit also if note entry is impossible due to platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this after attempting. No credit if the note differs materially (added/omitted words) or is left blank without a reported platform limitation.
items.justification: Action 2 entered exactly: 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note' into the Note field; State 3 confirms Type and note are filled.
items.applicable_evidence: Single (latest) screenshot shows the Note field containing 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note'.
items.post_image_justification: The exact specified note text was entered.

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: The agent clicked Save exactly once (Action 3) and encountered a server timeout ('no reply from the server within 0.6 s'), an uncontrollable platform error. The final output clearly reported the blocker ('The save did not complete'). Per Best Effort/Uncontrollable Blockers, award full credit.
items.applicable_evidence: Single (latest) screenshot shows a pink banner: 'The server did not answer. Try again later.' Save button is present; action history shows exactly one Save click.
items.post_image_justification: A server timeout is an uncontrollable blocker. The agent attempted to save exactly once and reported the failure, satisfying best-effort per the principles.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: The only edits were setting Type to 'Triage' and entering the specified note, followed by one Save attempt. No other fields or records were modified.
items.applicable_evidence: Single (latest) screenshot shows only 'Type: Triage' and the specified Note filled; no other fields appear modified.
items.post_image_justification: No unrelated changes were made beyond setting Type and entering the note.

side_effects.reasoning: The agent worked within the clinic app on patient p1, set Type to Triage, entered the exact note, and attempted a single save. A server timeout blocked completion, which was reported. There were no substitutions, no duplicate saves leading to multiple encounters, and no additional fields or unrelated records were modified. No material side effects beyond the requested task occurred, and all relevant aspects were already covered by existing criteria.
